episodes.synopsis: Musashi, Kojiro, and Tsugumi meet up with the gathering Uesugi Alliance in an effort to learn more about Kojiro's father. But with a battle against the Kishin of Awaji Island looming, the assembled forces might not be in the mood to indulge outsiders...
episodes.title: The Uesugi Band

episodes.synopsis: After volunteering to take part in a duel for the leadership of his unit, Musashi is confronted with a grim reality.
episodes.title: Humiliation On-board

episodes.synopsis: Musashi's troubles in the Shimazu Unit seem to get worse and worse, with accusations of desertion and espionage thrown his way. At least he can turn to the gentle Michiru to take his side... or can he?
episodes.title: Equals

episodes.synopsis: With the connection between Musashi and Michiru, the location of the Goddess Obsidian ends up being discovered by Yataro, who immediately warns the Black Dogs, and the group assembles a strategy to recover her.
episodes.title: The War God's Mantle

episodes.synopsis: Two of the Obsidian Eight are assaulting the Uesugi castle with Yamata no Orochi, while a third member kidnaps Musashi and tries to convince Michiru to kill him.
episodes.title: Memories of Stone

episodes.synopsis: Battle lines are drawn, with the Obsidian Brotherhood out to defend Yamata no Orochi and capture the Obsidian Goddess, while Musashi works with the Uesugi Band to slay the Kishin and rescue his friends.
episodes.title: Tactician Battle

episodes.synopsis: Naoe Kanetatsu of the Uesugi Bushi is facing off against Inukawa Seiroku of the Obsidian Eight. But how can he hope to defeat someone whose power seems to be inflicting physical trauma at will?
episodes.title: A Matter of Trust

episodes.synopsis: Shiro's unique powers are enough to overwhelm an entire group of Bushi by himself. Does Naotora really stand a chance?
episodes.title: Leaving Your Mark

episodes.synopsis: It's up to Musashi's squad to defeat Yataro, but the Shimazu siblings heading up their assault don't seem to be on the same page anymore.
episodes.title: Clash of the Shimazu

episodes.synopsis: The struggle to keep the white serpent from empowering Yamata no Orochi becomes desperate, as the truth behind the friction among the Shimazu brothers is revealed.
episodes.title: Older and Younger Brothers

episodes.synopsis: When everything seemed to have ended with the death of Orochi, the bushi discovered that in reality the fight had only begun.
episodes.title: Greatsword of the Black Goddess

episodes.synopsis: Musashi tried to save Michiru desperately while the young man's feelings seemed to resigned to his death, something that the young bushi was not willing to accept.
episodes.title: Oath
